rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive Cloudflare management through 18 tools covering zone management, DNS record CRUD operations, Transform Rules for request/response header modification and URL rewrites, Page Rules for redirects and cache settings, and cache purging. Runs locally via stdio with no third-party service dependencies, featuring Pydantic input validation, SecretStr token protection, and automated CVE scanning. Available as a PyPI package or containerized via Hummingbird-based image.
